summary: Techlott Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing receipt of an OTC Markets notice that its common stock's closing bid price remained below $0.01 for over 30 consecutive days, breaching OTCQB continued eligibility criteria. A 90-day cure period runs until October 26, 2026, requiring a $0.01 or greater closing bid for 10 consecutive trading days. Imminent removal occurs if bid falls below $0.001 for five consecutive trading days. No board action or advisors named; watch for potential reverse stock split or compliance efforts to maintain quotation.
